utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, it’s still on. We could really use help finding the screws, duct tape, and small tools first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just wanted to make sure. I can help with the screws and duct tape first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right—what’s the latest on the repair drive? If there’s anything I should bring or help with, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still haven’t seen the details yet—what exactly needs fixing, and when is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not sure of the details either—I just heard it’s for a few broken things around the neighborhood. I can check with the organizers and let you know the time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s been busy already—folks are really turning out for the repair drive. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — appreciate it. Send me the route and total stops when you have them, and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll send you the route and total stops as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s going well so far—people are really showing up to help. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great to hear—I'm still on the lookout for the screws, duct tape, and small tools. Just keep me posted if anything changes for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out for those screws, duct tape, and small tools and let you know if anything changes for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — if I hear any specific needs while I’m out, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’m still waiting on the exact repair list and route, but I’ll pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping an eye on the school pickup route, and I’ll let you know right away if I spot the repair drive and what they’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. Please let me know as soon as you see it, especially the time and what they’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’m still watching the school pickup route, and I’ll let you know the time and what they’re fixing as soon as I spot the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what needs the most help at the repair drive right now?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Tools and a few spare parts are the biggest need right now. I still need the final route, stop count, and repair list so I can tell people exactly what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I’ll help with the final route, stop count, and repair list. Just send me the details, and I’ll make sure people know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Just remind me what’s needed and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mostly the small stuff: tools, spare parts, and basic patch supplies for the weekend. If you’ve got anything that needs fixing, bring it by now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, got it—tools, spare parts, and patch supplies for the weekend. I’ll check my shed and bring over anything useful, and I’ll see if I’ve got something that needs fixing too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate it. The repair drive is still Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll keep sharing it around and let folks know it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on. I could use help spreading the word and sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the donations and help spread the word. What should I start with?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Start with sorting the donations, please. Then we can spread the word after.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mainly hands for the heavy stuff and someone to sort the drop-off pile. What do you want to take on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the drop-off pile and help with the heavier stuff for a bit—just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — start by sorting the drop-off pile by size, then we can lift the heavier items together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a few basic tools and help however Pia needs most. Just let me know what’s still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I still need the confirmed time and exact meeting spot for the repair drive so I don’t send anyone to the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t got the confirmed time or exact spot yet, but I’ll check and get back to you as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I’ll message you the pickup details and a time shortly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks, Mara. I’ll keep an eye out for your message.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll send it over soon, and if anything changes I’ll update you right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I still haven’t seen the repair-drive details yet—what exactly needs fixing, and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on, right? I haven’t seen the details yet either.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think so, yes — I just haven’t seen the full details either. If you get the flyer, send it my way and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly the usual stuff—small home fixes, broken appliances, and anything neighbors need a hand with. Vik said he’d spread the word later, so hopefully more people show up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s the plan—I’m going to stop by later and keep mentioning it to folks around the block. Hopefully we can get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, Vik—thanks for helping spread the word. I’m hoping a few more neighbors come by with small fixes they need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t got the full details yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the date and what’s getting fixed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — please do. Once you know the date and what’s being repaired, let me know so I can plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep my ears open and pass along the date and repair details as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still watching near the school pickup route. As soon as I spot the repair drive, I’ll send you the route, stop count, and what they’re repairing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal—please send the route and stop count as soon as you have them so I can check the drive time and staffing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll send the route and stop count as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina — just a quick update: the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa. Do you have the final route, stop count, and repair list yet so I can share the details?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Not quite yet — I’m still finalizing those details, but I’ll send them along as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for checking in — we’re still pinning down the biggest repair needs and the final time/place. I’ll send the details as soon as they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — just send me the main repair item and the confirmed time/place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll send you the main repair item plus the confirmed time and place as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help spread the word and I’ll bring a few basic tools this Sunday at the community center. If there’s anything specific you still need, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Please bring a hammer, a screwdriver set, and any spare tape you’ve got this Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring a hammer, a screwdriver set, and whatever spare tape I have this Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: The repair drive is still Sunday at the community center, and I’m spreading the word. If you want to help, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly small home repairs like leaky faucets, patching walls, and checking broken outlets. If I hear of anyone who can help, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Ira — I’ll keep passing that along and let people know it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: What’s the latest on the repair drive, and is there anything I should bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s on Sunday at the community center now. If you can bring any screws, duct tape, or small tools, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—Sunday at the community center. I can bring some screws and a couple small tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m not totally caught up yet — I think the biggest help is still needed with the actual repairs. I’ll check on the timing and details for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — that helps. Please let me know the timing and details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll get the timing and a quick list of what still needs fixing and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — I’m still spreading the word. If you can, help sort the donations by type.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that. I’ll sort the donations by type and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks, Uli. I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know if anything else comes up.
